sentences.text: This animal was a medium-sized carnivore featuring a tapered body shape and flipper-like limbs.
The species G. leedsi measured between 2.25 and 3.11 meters, while G. acutus grew to 3.77 meters.
Scientists named the genus Gracilineustes in 2010.
Remains have been recovered from Middle to Late Jurassic rock formations in England and France.
The genus falls within the family Metriorhynchidae and the subfamily Metriorhynchinae.
Gracilineustes leedsi serves as the type species for this genus.
It lived during the Callovian to Kimmeridgian stages, roughly 165.3 to 152.21 million years ago.
This carnivore spent most or all of its life swimming in the ocean.
